    C,F=by_name["C"],by_name["F"]
    for target_name in ("G","H"):
        target=by_name[target_name]
        z=sp.symbols("z0:8"); V=sp.Matrix(4,2,z)
        eq=[]
        for x in group:
            for flux in group:
                tensor=sum((sp.kronecker_product(representation(C,a,x),representation(F,b,x)) for a in group for b in group if compose(a,b)==flux),sp.zeros(4))
                eq.extend(list(tensor*V-V*representation(target,flux,x)))
        A,_=sp.linear_eq_to_matrix(eq,z); ns=A.nullspace(); assert len(ns)==1
        W=sp.Matrix(4,2,ns[0]); norm=sp.simplify((W.H*W)[0,0]); W=sp.simplify(W/sp.sqrt(norm))
        assert sp.simplify(W.H*W-sp.eye(2))==sp.zeros(2)
        print(target_name, W.tolist())
    raise SystemExit
'''
exec(compile(s.replace(mark,ins+mark),str(p),'exec'))
